newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton futures end lower ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton futures end lower ahead of holiday.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled lower before a two-day Christmas holiday, in thin and rangebound trade.
March cotton ended 0.29 cent lower at 75.71 cents per pound, traded 76.10 to 75.67 cents. The back months finished unchanged to 0.23 lower.
The NYCE will be closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Trade will resume Thursday.
Support was pegged at 75.30 cents and resistance at 77.00 cents, basis the March contract.
Amid a dearth of fundamental news, industry sources are looking forward to the annual Beltwide Cotton Conferences, which will take place from Jan 6 to Jan 10, in New Orleans.
